canonical_title: Delos Data raises $100 million for heterogeneous AI data-center networking
treatment: Repeat only for product specifications, silicon availability, benchmark results, major customer deployment, or another material financing/manufacturing milestone.
known_facts: Delos Data raised $100 million to develop chips and software for moving data inside increasingly heterogeneous AI data centers.
The company is targeting flexible networking across mixed accelerator architectures as inference and agent workloads diversify compute fleets.
Former Intel CEO Pat Gelsinger's Playground participated in the financing.
reinclude_only_if: Delos Data publishes concrete chip architecture, interconnect, bandwidth, latency, or power specifications.
A major cloud or AI infrastructure customer deploys the technology.
Production silicon or reproducible performance data becomes available.
notes: Funding is notable mainly as a signal that heterogeneous agentic inference is creating demand for accelerator-agnostic data movement.
